lede: Did you know? Back in 2024, DJ Amit Kirti took a live DJ set inside the Bangladesh Metro Rail.
body:
Did you know? Back in 2024, [@djamitkirti](https://www.instagram.com/djamitkirti/) played a **DJ set in the Dhaka Metro Rail**, or as the caption puts it, the Bangladesh Metrorail. Our verdict: he "definitely knew the vision". HARD!

## DJ Amit Kirti's DJ set in the Dhaka Metro Rail

B-POP Tags' graphic spells it out: "DJ Amit Kirti did the first ever live DJ set inside the Metro Rail back in April 2024." It shows the DJ in dark sunglasses, gesturing toward the camera, above a green-and-red Metro Rail train, with a prompt to "swipe to see the snippet". The hashtags, #dhaka, #djset, #metrorail and #banglarave, say the rest. Two years on, it's still one of those moments people bring up when they talk about how far the scene will go to find a stage.

## Why it still resonates

A set on a train carriage is a reminder that the scene finds stages wherever it can, a spirit that runs through the story of [OMDG and Bangladesh's rave revolution](post:omdg-dhaka-rave-revolution). For more of the city's party energy, see [DJ Shimmerie and Dhaka's underground parties](post:dj-shimmerie-dhaka-underground-parties) and [the electric rise of Bangladesh's sound](post:electric-rise-of-bangladesh).

Find more DJs in [Music & Rave](topic:music) or on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcYlglUCEZ5/)

faq.q: When did DJ Amit Kirti play inside the Metro Rail?
faq.a: According to B-POP Tags' graphic, DJ Amit Kirti did a live DJ set inside the Metro Rail in April 2024. The post includes a snippet of the set.
